description: This file defines the IQueueAdapter interface and related extension methods for abstracting queue operations within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It specifies methods for queuing message batches, creating receivers, and metadata properties about the adapter.

classes.name: IQueueAdapter
classes.description: An interface representing a stream queue storage adapter that abstracts underlying queue implementations, providing methods for queuing batches, creating receivers, and indicating capabilities such as rewindability and data direction.

classes.name: QueueAdapterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to simplify queue message operations, such as queuing individual messages in addition to batches.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a batch of events to the queue with associated stream ID, token, and request context.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns a receiver interface for a specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageAsync
methods.description: Extension method that simplifies queuing a single event by internally calling QueueMessageBatchAsync with a singleton list.
